hooks.command: d="$PWD"; while [ ! -f "$d/.code-flow/scripts/cf_codex_hook.py" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d="$(dirname "$d")"; done; f="$d/.code-flow/scripts/cf_codex_hook.py"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then python3 "$f"; fi
hooks.commandWindows: py -3 -c "import pathlib,runpy,sys; roots=(pathlib.Path.cwd(), *pathlib.Path.cwd().parents); script=next((root/'.code-flow/scripts/cf_codex_hook.py' for root in roots if (root/'.code-flow/scripts/cf_codex_hook.py').is_file()), None); sys.path.insert(0,str(script.parent)) if script else None; runpy.run_path(str(script),run_name='__main__') if script else None"
